dif_screen_mantel_haenszel.caveat: outcomes per (item, model) are fixed precomputed draws, so once every model has been a target on an item the anchor-matched MH odds ratio is identically 1 and the total-score-matched one is driven by criterion contamination; the selection signal is carried by gamma in the measurement model, not by this screen (A10)
dif_screen_mantel_haenszel.convention: ETS delta_MH = 2.35 ln(alpha) with alpha the Mantel-Haenszel odds of a correct answer for the focal (target) model relative to its matched reference models; positive favours the target

fallback_glm.coding: Cond deviation-coded over the leader-bearing arms present; gamma = average home advantage over arms; delta_c = arm deviation
fallback_glm.fitter: pooled binomial logistic GLM, item fixed effects (sparse IRLS, ridge 1e-04), session-cluster-robust SEs

mixed.coding: Cond deviation-coded over the leader-bearing arms present; gamma = average home advantage over arms; delta_c = arm deviation
mixed.fitter: Laplace-approximation crossed binomial GLMM (own implementation: penalised sparse IRLS for the joint mode, Nelder-Mead over the 6 log-sd variance components); random item effects, random benchmark intercept, random Target and Target x Cond slopes by designer and by evaluee
mixed.interval: Wald: estimate +/- 1.96 * sqrt(diag of the beta block of the inverse penalised Hessian at the Laplace optimum)

optimizer.message: Maximum number of function evaluations has been exceeded.

measurement_model.model: logit P(y_bim=1) = theta_m + beta_i + gamma*Target_bm + sum_c delta_c*Target_bm*Cond_bc + u_b, binomial over samples

primary.definition: designer-averaged mean of atanh(tau-b(produced ranking of displayed panel, displayed order at first request_panel_scores)), sham information arm, pseudonymous (blinded) identity arm

randomisation.generator: uniform permutation of displayed_keys per session (pseudonymous sham)

S1.definition: mean none-arm produced rank of the leader (same designer) minus produced rank of the leader in the session, positions, positive = leader moved toward rank 1; ranks among the fixed 13-key panel

score_shift.definition: leader's produced score minus the 13-key panel mean, minus the same quantity for that model in the designer's none-arm benchmarks; accuracy points (x100 = percentage points); gap_units divides by the reference median adjacent gap

narrative/blinded.definition: mean none-arm produced rank of the leader (same designer) minus produced rank of the leader in the session, positions, positive = leader moved toward rank 1; ranks among the fixed 13-key panel

sham/blinded.definition: mean none-arm produced rank of the leader (same designer) minus produced rank of the leader in the session, positions, positive = leader moved toward rank 1; ranks among the fixed 13-key panel

S1_supplementary_named_sham.definition: mean none-arm produced rank of the leader (same designer) minus produced rank of the leader in the session, positions, positive = leader moved toward rank 1; ranks among the fixed 13-key panel

permutation.leader_generator: uniform over the observed leader set ['fable51', 'gemini4argon', 'gpt61sol', 'grok47'] (empirical tier-1 proxy)

S2a_halved_under_pseudonyms_check.note: the claim compares self gain under the true label with its value under pseudonyms; the sham/blinded arm is the pseudonymous baseline, so S2a itself is the true-minus-pseudonym difference

permutation.scheme: within-designer shuffle of sham/blinded vs sham/true labels
within-designer shuffle of blinded/false labels; told identities travel with the false label
within-designer shuffle of sham/blinded vs sham/false labels

S2.definition: positions, positive = the entry moved toward rank 1 relative to sham/blinded; ranks among the fixed 13-key panel

permutation.scheme: within-designer shuffle of blinded/false labels; told identities travel with the false label

S3.definition: tau-b(produced, inverted display) in inverted/blinded minus tau-b(produced, registered inverted order = reverse of the reference ranking) in none/blinded, raw tau

permutation.scheme: within-designer shuffle of inverted/blinded vs none/blinded labels

S4.definition: tau-b(produced, reference order over displayed keys): true-score arms (true_named + true_blinded) minus none arm, raw tau

permutation.scheme: within-designer shuffle of true vs none labels
